steps.name: For the Glory of Portugal
steps.text: Well sailed, João! Word of your exploits reaches Duke Leon's court. Your voyage for Portugal's glory has begun.

steps.name: Proving Your Worth
steps.text: Your discoveries are the talk of Lisbon. The Duke watches your progress with growing pride.

steps.name: Royal Favor
steps.text: The crown grants you an audience. "Continue, João — perhaps the legend of Atlantis is more than myth."

steps.name: The Atlantis Legend
steps.text: Fragments of an ancient map hint at a sunken continent. The secret of Atlantis feels within reach.

steps.name: The Lost Continent
steps.text: At last — the lost land of Atlantis rises from legend! Your name will echo through the ages, son of Duke Leon Franco.

steps.name: The Red-Haired Pirate
steps.text: Your name is whispered in every tavern. The trail of your brother and your beloved grows warmer.

steps.name: Hunting the Trail
steps.text: Each sunken ship brings you closer to the ones responsible. Portugal will answer for their loss.

steps.name: Growing Notoriety
steps.text: The red-haired pirate is feared across the seas. Your enemies know you are coming.

steps.name: The Betrayer's Trail
steps.text: The web of betrayal unravels. You can almost see the faces of those who took everything from you.

steps.name: Vengeance at Last
steps.text: It is done. The sea has claimed your vengeance. May your brother and your beloved finally rest in peace.

steps.name: Secret Orders
steps.text: King Henry's seal glints in your hand. Sail as a privateer, Sir Otto — and keep your mission secret.

steps.name: Proving Loyalty
steps.text: Your deeds reach London. The King is pleased with his secret knight.

steps.name: Rising Star
steps.text: Spain's admirals curse your name. The Spanish Fleet weakens under your privateering.

steps.name: The King's Trust
steps.text: The King himself commends you. England's dominance of the seas is nearly assured.

steps.name: Hero of England
steps.text: The Spanish Fleet is broken! King Henry VIII names you a hero of England. Your secret mission is complete.

steps.name: Mercator's Request
steps.text: Your old friend Mercator writes: "Plot the world for me, Ernst. Every coast, every port."

steps.name: Charting the Coast
steps.text: Your charts grow detailed. Sailors everywhere will soon navigate by your maps.

steps.name: Unknown Lands
steps.text: Beyond the known coasts lie wonders no map has ever shown. You ink them in, one by one.

steps.name: The Far Reaches
steps.text: From Lisbon to the farthest shore, your map spans the known world. Mercator will be astonished.

steps.name: The Complete Map
steps.text: It is finished — a detailed map of the entire world! Your name joins Mercator's among the great geographers.

steps.name: A Family's Burden
steps.text: The Conti debt hangs over you, but every coin earned is a step toward freedom.

steps.name: First Treasures
steps.text: Glittering treasure! The rumors were true — the world is full of riches for those who seek them.

steps.name: Exotic Riches
steps.text: Your coffers swell. The moneylenders of Genoa grow nervous — the Conti name is rising again.

steps.name: The Great Haul
steps.text: Another vault of treasure! Your exploits as a treasure hunter are legendary.

steps.name: Debt Repaid
steps.text: The last coin is paid. The Conti family debt is erased — and you are richer than ever. The world is yours!

steps.name: A Merchant's Dream
steps.text: From the bazaars of Istanbul to distant shores, your trading journey begins. Fortune favors the bold.

steps.name: Establishing Routes
steps.text: New ports, new markets, new profits. Your trade network begins to span the seas.

steps.name: Building Wealth
steps.text: Your ships return heavy with goods and gold. Merchants from Venice to Alexandria know your name.

steps.name: Master of Trade
steps.text: Your trade routes circle the globe. No market is beyond your reach.

steps.name: Trade Magnate
steps.text: You are a magnate of trade, wealthier than sultans! The boy who struggled in Istanbul now rules the markets of the world.

steps.name: The Duke's Commission
steps.text: In Lisbon, Duke Leon entrusts you with a commission and a generous sum. Your quiet days translating ancient texts in Sintra are over — the sea calls, Isabella.

steps.name: The Athens Library
steps.text: In the great library of Athens you decipher the way to awaken the red stone: gather spiritual power from the four most legendary sites on Earth — the Pyramids, Stonehenge, Bermuda, and Yingzhou.

steps.name: The Four Sacred Sites
steps.text: Spiritual power hums within the red stone. But the Spanish fleet shadows you — they too covet Yubel's magic. Stay sharp, Isabella.

steps.name: The Spanish Intercept
steps.text: The Spanish fleet moves to seize you! At the brink, Yubel's magic flares — and in a flash of light the four of you are hurled into another world…

steps.name: The Way Home
steps.text: Stranded in a strange world, you and your companions search for the way back. Every discovery brings you closer to home.

steps.name: Sending Yudora Home
steps.text: With the spiritual power gathered, you open the way home and see Yudora safely back to her own world. Your fantastical journey becomes legend, Isabella!
